question: Select the most appropriate option for blank (1)
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**rid**" means to make someone or something free of unwanted or troublesome items. (छुटकारा पाने के लिए)
 
• In the context of the passage, households want to get** rid of rats**, meaning they want to eliminate them.
 
• The other options: "**void**," "**empty**," and "**relieve**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Households these days resort to chemicals to get rid__ of rats.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Void (शून्य)**: means not valid or legally binding.
 
• **Empty (खाली)**: means containing nothing; not filled or occupied.
 
• **Relieve (राहत देना)**: means to ease or alleviate pain or distress.
